coreAttributes.name: nipple weight
coreAttributes.description: A matched pair of heavy metal weights, each fitted with a padded clamp designed to grip firmly around a nipple. Worn for long enough, the constant downward pull does lasting work on the wearer's breasts, drawing them into a permanently lower, heavier hang.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(clamp)] the weights into place on [npc.her] [npc.nipples], and [npc.she] [npc.verb(let)] out a slow breath as [npc.her] [npc.breasts+] are dragged down by the sudden pull.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(clamp)] the weights into place on [npc2.namePos] [npc2.nipples], and [npc2.her] [npc2.breasts+] are dragged down by the sudden pull.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly [npc.verb(snap)] the weights shut on [npc2.namePos] [npc2.nipples], letting them drop without warning so that [npc2.her] [npc2.breasts+] are yanked down by the sudden pull.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(unclamp)] the weights from [npc.her] [npc.nipples], and [npc.her] [npc.breasts+] rise a little as the pull is released.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(unclamp)] the weights from [npc2.namePos] [npc2.nipples], and [npc2.her] [npc2.breasts+] rise a little as the pull is released.
displacementText.otherRough: With no regard for [npc2.her] comfort, [npc.name] [npc.verb(yank)] the weights straight off [npc2.namePos] [npc2.nipples].
